label: prop:qbeta-canonical-markov-weights-explicit-instance
title: Explicit $\sqrt q$-bearing instance of $\mathbf{CanonicalMarkovWeightsH3}$ (class is inhabitable)
html:
Explicit instance of canonical Markov weights

The canonical Markov-weight hypothesis (stated in Per-block character closed forms for \chi_\lambda(\Delta_{T_\beta})(q) over H_3(q) §Extension #4) is satisfiable. An explicit \sqrt q-bearing instance is:

  y_{(3)}(q) = z(q), \qquad
  y_{(2,1)}(q) = \tfrac{1}{2} - z(q), \qquad
  y_{(1,1,1)}(q) = z(q),

where z(q) = \sqrt q / (1 + q) = 1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) is an auxiliary algebraic function used solely to inhabit this hypothesis (distinct from the Markov parameter q^3/(q^2+1)); it witnesses that the normalisation condition is non-empty, and nothing downstream identifies this auxiliary z(q) with the paper's Markov parameter.
